name: Terrarium 30x30x40 +3D
label: Medium terrarium
lead: Glass terrarium measuring 30x30x40 cm with a handmade 3D background. Volume: 36.0 liters, vertical format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: A 30x30 cm base and 40 cm of height make this the lowest of our vertical models on this base, with 36 liters of volume. The back is covered by a 3D styrofoam background, which serves geckos as one more climbing wall, alongside the glass and branches.

A young crested or gargoyle gecko has enough height here for two to three branches at different levels and a plant for cover. An adult fits, but is more comfortable in the 50 cm model. Green anoles and smaller day geckos need a basking spot near the top, and tree frogs a damper floor with live plants.

The 30x30x50 and 30x30x55 models offer ten or fifteen centimeters more. If you plan a drainage layer and live plants, tell us when ordering so that we can adjust the height. The outer film is chosen from 34 patterns. A terrarium with a changed height is ready in 7 to 14 days and arrives by courier.
